title: I125: F-M6-05's consistency, derive against goops' refusals (HUMAN_ANSWERS Q105 (6); Q117 (3) and (5)), choice (B): under the protocol opt-in run_unbound_reason "goops" (holon run --unbound-reason goops), a Go-op law that cannot be bound and names an op the generated Go-op model writes as '# <op>: unsupported (<reason>)' stays UNKNOWN and carries goops' refusal (its class and reason, read from the generated model file) as its reason instead of the bare binding error. Derive is untouched: the derived law set, every decision and every other law's record are the same with and without the opt-in.

thresholds.doc: No number is a gate (BUILD_PLAN §4, M6 exit). Each prediction holds or misses as stated; a miss is reported, never forced. P1-P6 are on the planted fixture tests_m6/fixtures/i125 (written from the Go specification alone), unit inputs and Morph's committed outputs. P7-P8 are smoke on contaminated data (I51's corpus; the lead, with Q98): the corpus is where a key is designed, never where generality is claimed (only I114's sealed pair). Laws are reported as aggregates only; decided counts never split PROVED from REFUTED (Q56, Q89); stage reasons only for stages before any decision (Q72). A pre-decision refusal is not a verdict (Q113): the op_refused laws are counted as refusals, with stage (run, before any decision) and goops' reason class.
thresholds.choice: (B), emission with the reason. The law set is unchanged; the opt-in only replaces, for a law already UNKNOWN by its binding, the binding error with goops' refusal (the binding error is kept in the attempt as binding_error). It decides nothing new, no law becomes easier to decide, and no denominator moves: the derived count is the same with and without the opt-in, so a smaller denominator cannot read as a gain. (A) was not chosen: not deriving a law over a refused op shrinks the derived set, close to AGENTS.md rule 2; the lead preferred (B).
thresholds.which_side: derive is the side out of step under the opaque reading (it emits a law over every op of the document, as PAR's totality rule says); goops is right to refuse the ops outside its classes. The fix aligns the reporting, not the law set: neither the law nor the model is edited to make it bind (Q105 (6)).
thresholds.effect_on_m0_m3: none. M0-M3's derived law sets and records move only by re-stamp (generator_sha256), because no Morph protocol or gate names the opt-in and holon run without --unbound-reason computes nothing new (P6). Any move in M3's committed law set would stop the key (Q96).
thresholds.instruments: spec/M6/lib/i125_run.json (base_protocol plus exactly run_unbound_reason "goops" and its doc, with its own doc, iteration, out and go_machines.out) and tests_m6/test_i125_derive_goops_consistency.py (every check)
thresholds.base: the lead claude/holon-v2-bend2-c6z3cd at 326dcc01 for the build and the planted tests; the measured runs come after the next landing (Q117 (2)), on the base the coordinator names, merged by a merge commit before the first measured run, its sha and the base protocol's sha256 recorded in the report (Q104 (4), (5))
thresholds.protocol_rule: spec/M6/lib/i125_run.json is base_protocol plus exactly run_unbound_reason "goops" and run_unbound_reason_doc (and its own doc, iteration, out, go_machines.out), checked by TestRegressions.test_p6_protocol_is_its_base_plus_the_opt_in. At the coordinator's word on the measured runs' base, it is regenerated from that base's spec/M6/lib/base_run.json by this rule (a mechanical rebase, no other change).
thresholds.baseline: I124's baseline (base 326dcc01, base_run.json 1d45d89b…, smoke on contaminated data): 14 of 20 entries ran; 268 laws derived, 1 decided (PROVED and REFUTED together, Q56), 267 UNKNOWN, of which 234 binding refusals with no checker run (all PAR laws on Go-op components: 188 on ok_<op>, 46 on the op's name; goops' reasons: straight-line 108 + 36, loop 47 + 17 + 10 + 4, other single-term refusals 12). The baseline of record is the base protocol's own run on the named base, run beside I125's (Q104 (2)).

predictions.claim: (goops' output) The Go-op model generated for the planted package defines gate_Low and ok_gate_Low and writes gate_Quot and gate_Twice as '# <op>: unsupported (<reason>)' lines, defining neither the op nor ok_<op>; holon.codecrun.goops_refusals reads from that text exactly those two ops, gate_Quot of class straight-line and gate_Twice of class loop.

(planted, under the opt-in) Every law over gate_Quot or gate_Twice (at least one each) is UNKNOWN with exactly one attempt {kind op_refused, ops [{op, class, reason}], binding_error}, its reason the generated model's comment text verbatim, its bound naming that reason, no witness, no law or proof file; without the opt-in the same laws are UNKNOWN with exactly one binding attempt.

(planted, scope) With and without the opt-in, on this branch's code: the derived laws, DERIVATION.json and the generated models are identical; every record not over a refused op (gate_Low's included, at least one) is identical as G1 compares (generator_sha256 and seconds stripped); the decided count is the same (PROVED and REFUTED together, Q56).
(planted, without the opt-in) Under the base protocol, this branch's code and the base code (326dcc01, a git worktree) produce the same laws, DERIVATION.json, models and records (G1's comparison).

(soundness, units) holon.codecrun.op_refused_res returns a record only for a Go-op law whose binding already failed and whose statement (comments stripped) names, as M.<op> or M.ok_<op>, an op the model text refuses; a law that binds, a binding failure naming no refused op, a non-Go-op law and the option off are untouched (None). The record is UNKNOWN; it decides nothing.

(control) No committed M0-M3 record carries an op_refused attempt; no protocol other than I125's names run_unbound_reason; I125's protocol is its base plus exactly the opt-in; the base protocol's milestone runner gets no new argument. Morph's M0-M3 move only by re-stamp: holon land dirty re-makes no M0-M2 law, gate-M0 passes, gate-M1 and gate-M2 pass (or fail on G1 alone and pass with generator_sha256 stripped), gate-M3 partial passes; no M3 law file moves.
predictions.check: tests_m6/test_i125_derive_goops_consistency.py::TestRegressions, and the gates run locally and reported (docs/iterations/I125.md)

predictions.claim: (corpus smoke, contaminated) On the named base, the base protocol's run and I125's give the same derived, decided (PROVED and REFUTED together, Q56) and UNKNOWN totals: the opt-in moves no denominator and no verdict.

(corpus smoke, contaminated) Every law the base run records UNKNOWN by its binding names an op goops refuses (F-M6-05 is the whole binding wall: I124's 234, re-counted on the named base), so under the opt-in none is left with a bare binding error and all carry goops' refusal; by goops' class, straight-line 144 to 156 and loop 78 to 90 (I124's table: straight-line 108 + 36, loop 47 + 17 + 10 + 4, and the 12 other single-term refusals in one or the other).
(confinement) Nothing committed under results/M6/I125 names a law id.
